purpose: keing1/reward-hacking-evals (arXiv 2605.02269) spec-gaming suite on the two Qwen pre/post-RL pairs (OOD w.r.t. their RL training)

evals.pilot: first 16/16/8/8 of the same permutation, run first in the same job

post.type: LoRA r32 on pre, applied at runtime

control.type: LoRA r32 on pre (RL without loophole)

pair1.serving: vLLM 0.28.0 bf16, 1xH100: --enable-lora --max-lora-rank 32 --max-loras 2 --lora-modules post=... control=... --generation-config vllm --max-model-len 32768 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 --max-num-seqs 128 --seed 1234 --trust-remote-code; VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER=0; no reasoning parser

sampling.system_prompt: none for MC; authors' email system prompt for Email

pair1.chat_template:
Qwen3-4B tokenizer template; assistant turn pre-filled with '<think>

</think>

' (verified locally and in-job by lora_sanity.py token-count match)

post.type: LoRA r32 on pre, converted (exact, scale 1.0) to /data/home/jxcai/sigil-a/hf_models/qwen3.5-9b-rh-step110-lora-vllm (r96), applied at runtime

pair2.serving: vLLM 0.28.0 bf16, 1xH100: --enable-lora --max-lora-rank 128 --max-loras 1 --lora-modules post=... --limit-mm-per-prompt {"image":0,"video":0} --max-model-len 32768 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 --max-num-seqs 128 --seed 1234 --trust-remote-code; VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER=0; no reasoning parser

sampling.thinking: native, template default -> assistant turn starts '<think>\n'
sampling.system_prompt: none for MC; authors' email system prompt for Email

stats: Wilson 95% per arm; Newcombe 95% on arm-minus-pre over intersected ids; two-sided Fisher exact p (compare.py / summarize.py)

aux_llm.pair1: same server, model 'pre' (= Qwen3-4B, enable_thinking=false, T=0.7, top_p=0.8, max_tokens 1024: team6 defaults)
aux_llm.pair2: second vLLM server Qwen3-4B @1cfa9a72 on the same GPU (AUX_GPU_UTIL 0.18, main GPU_UTIL 0.72), same aux sampling
